name.en: Rail system on trapezoidal / corrugated metal sheet (screwed clamps to sheet crests)
name.es: Sistema de rieles sobre chapa trapezoidal / ondulada metálica (sujeción atornillada a las crestas)

description.en: Aluminium rails run across the metal sheet profile and are fixed to the sheet crests or purlins with stainless thread-forming screws with sealing washer (calotte type) through the sheet. Modules are held by mid and end clamps on the rails. Reference product family: K2 Systems BasicRail / SolidRail on trapezoidal sheet metal.
description.es: Perfiles de aluminio se disponen transversalmente sobre la perfilería de la chapa y se fijan a las crestas o a las correas con tornillos autorroscantes de acero inoxidable con arandela de estanqueidad (tipo calota). Los módulos se sujetan con garras intermedias y de extremo sobre los rieles. Familia de referencia: K2 Systems BasicRail / SolidRail sobre chapa trapezoidal.

typical_use: Trapezoidal or corrugated steel/aluminium roof sheeting over purlins, fixed without roof penetration beyond the sheet fastener.
applicable_standards: EN 1991-1-3 (snow loads, to be applied by the designer)
EN 1991-1-4 (wind actions, to be applied by the designer)
EN 1999-1-1 (aluminium design, to be applied by the designer; not verified in this research)
ISO 898-1:2013 (carbon steel fasteners, property classes; reference only)

grounding_bonding: Module frames bonded to rails with K2 TerraGrif grounding clips (stainless steel 301 TA) or TerraGrif QL for K2 Clamp 25-40. Compatibility depends on rail type and orientation per catalogue. Equipotential path and conductor sizing not verified.
installation_notes: Fix rails to the sheet crests with stainless thread-forming screws with EPDM sealing, suitable for 0.4 to 1.25 mm sheet (per K2 catalogue).
Hanger-bolt family manual lists solar fastener for trapezoidal sheet with calotte seal, pre-drill 8.0 mm general, 5.5 mm for identical roof and substructure (per K2 manual; verify for this sheet).
Thermal separation: at most every 17.60 m, gap at least 30 mm (K2 manual for SingleRail; verify for BasicRail).
Rail end to module frame at least 50 mm, rail cut length at least 700 mm, module block spacing at least 5 mm (K2 manual).
Torque values for the K2 clamp bolts and rail connectors were not found in the catalogue; use the manufacturer installation manual.
unverified_items: Rail cross-section dimensions in mm for BasicRail 22 and SolidRail (not found; only lengths are sourced).
Alloy temper: K2 states EN AW-6063 T66. 6005-T5 and 6063-T6 were not found in K2 sources.
Torque for clamps, rail connectors, end caps and TerraGrif grounding parts (not stated by K2 catalogue page).
Quantities per support, per rail and per row (not stated; 0 means unknown).
Fixing pitch, rail spacing and purlin requirements for trapezoidal sheet (not found).
Property class of stainless fasteners (ISO 3506-1 class such as A2-70 not confirmed; A2 = 1.4301 confirmed).
Self-tapping screw 6x38 is discontinued (K2); 6x22 variant code conflict noted.
Cable clip product for this family (not found).
